description: This pleasant circular walk explores the woodland in Flaunden Grove near Latimer. It's a fine area with peaceful woodland trails through Flaunden Grove and the adjacent Baldwin's Wood to enjoy. There's also lovely views of the River Chess and the surrounding Chilterns countryside to enjoy. You can continue your walking on the Chess Valley Walk .
